info.scriptSrcText: property this, radians, Xpos, loopX, Ypos, glow, COPTER, cableGuy, towerState, startY, glowList, glowListPointer, loopWidth, grabX, grabY, tiltAngleglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gDamagePercent, gCableLength, gPloshX, gRescueCount, gScore, gCableItem, gXVelChangeon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  tiltAngle = -50  glow = sprite(the currentSpriteNum + 1)  glow.blend = 100  COPTER = sprite(4)  cableGuy = sprite(6)  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  startY = Ypos  this.locZ = the currentSpriteNum + 104  glow.locZ = the currentSpriteNum + 105  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  ouchCount = 3  prevBolt = 0  boltOffset = -60  towerState = #NULL  glowList = []  repeat with i = 1 to 30    glowList.add(50 + (50 * cos(i * 12 * radians)))  end repeat  glowListPointer = 1  grabX = 0  grabY = 0endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    case towerState of      #NULL:        Xpos = Xpos + (gXVel + gXOffset)        if Xpos > loopX then          Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth        end if        if Xpos < -loopX then          Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth        end if        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos        this.rotation = tiltAngle        grabX = Xpos + (100 * cos((tiltAngle - 90) * radians))        grabY = Ypos + (100 * sin((tiltAngle - 90) * radians))        xDiff = cableGuy.locH - grabX        yDiff = cableGuy.locV - grabY        distToGuy = sqrt((xDiff * xDiff) + (yDiff * yDiff))        if (distToGuy < 6) and (gCableItem = 0) then          if gCableLength > 0 then            towerState = #GRABBED            gCableItem = 1          end if        end if      #GRABBED:        Xpos = Xpos + (gXVel + gXOffset)        if Xpos > loopX then          Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth        end if        if Xpos < -loopX then          Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth        end if        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos        this.rotation = tiltAngle        grabX = Xpos + (100 * cos((tiltAngle - 90) * radians))        grabY = Ypos + (100 * sin((tiltAngle - 90) * radians))        if soundBusy(4) = 0 then          puppetSound(4, member(39, "Sfx"))        end if        xDiff = float(COPTER.locH - gXVel - grabX)        yDiff = float(COPTER.locV + COPTER.Yvel - grabY)        distToCopter = sqrt((xDiff * xDiff) + (yDiff * yDiff))        toCopterVector = point(grabX, grabY) - COPTER.loc        if distToCopter > gCableLength then          pullVector = toCopterVector / float(distToCopter) * (distToCopter - gCableLength)          gXVelChange = gXVelChange - pullVector.locH          COPTER.Yvel = COPTER.Yvel + pullVector.locV          cableGuy.cableState = #GODOWN          if (pullVector.locH < 0) and (pullVector.locV > 0) then            tiltAngle = tiltAngle + 0.5          end if        end if        toCableGuyVector = point(grabX, grabY) - (cableGuy.loc + point(cableGuy.Xvel, cableGuy.Yvel))        pullVector = toCableGuyVector        cableGuy.Xvel = cableGuy.Xvel + pullVector.locH        cableGuy.Yvel = cableGuy.Yvel + pullVector.locV        if tiltAngle > 0 then          gScore = gScore + 500          towerState = #UP          gCableItem = 0          puppetSound(4, member(40, "Sfx"))          puppetSound(3, member(8, "Sfx"))          tiltAngle = 0          this.rotation = tiltAngle          gRescueCount = gRescueCount + 1        end if      #UP:        Xpos = Xpos + (gXVel + gXOffset)        if Xpos > loopX then          Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth        end if        if Xpos < -loopX then          Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth        end if        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos    end case  end ifend
